detached_structure.evidence: A small rectangular structure sits at the left edge of the central house near (300,395), but it looks like an attached porch or addition rather than a separate building.

signals.notes: The central house is heavily shaded and surrounded by dense mature tree canopy, which hides much of the yard. Its dark roof has a darker patch and a possible deck or patio on the north side, and an open lawn is visible to the west.
